formula_observations: Only film former is potato starch (position 2, right after water) plus guar hydroxypropyltrimonium chloride (position 6, cationic natural polymer, conditioning/light film). NO PVP, VP/VA, polyquaternium or acrylates. Propellants butane/propane at positions 3-4. No alcohol denat (matches 'ohne Alkohol'), no silicones, no oils. Aerosol foam, water-based, surfactant (cocamidopropyl betaine) generates the foam. Panthenol as the only care ingredient.
notes: Claim-vs-formula: pack/dm sell this as 'Haltegrad 4' / 'starker Halt' for 24 h, yet the formula is a starch-based natural-polymer system with no synthetic fixative at all (compare Taft Classic Halt 3 on dm: VP/VA + polyquaternium-11/-4 + acrylamide copolymer, i.e. a synthetic system with the LOWER number). Hold number is a brand-internal scale; scale max not printed in the dm text. Rossmann listing for same EAN seen in search (not INCI-checked). A hold number therefore cannot be mapped to fixative chemistry.

formula_observations: Care-led foam. Film former = Hydroxypropyl Starch (modified starch, position 2) + Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (position 9); Sucrose (position 5) adds light tack/film. NO synthetic fixative (no PVP, VP/VA, PQ, acrylates). Panthenol + Niacinamide as 'care' actives at positions 6-7. Propellants butane/propane at 3-4. No alcohol denat, no silicones, no oils. Cetrimonium chloride (position 13) as conditioner.
notes: Claim-vs-formula: dm 'Halt: starker Halt' but the brand's own text says 'natürlich aussehender Halt' and the formula is starch/sugar-based, so real hold is likely light-to-medium flexible; the strong label is the retailer filter, not a pack number. '3in1: stylt, repariert und pflegt' is marketing around panthenol/niacinamide (leave-in-like claims on a rinse-free foam). Same fixative family as Taft Volumen Halt 4 (starch + guar). Good 'care-led, ohne Alkohol' mousse example.

directions: Gut schütteln, Flasche kopfüber; apfelgroße Menge für mittellanges Haar im nassen Haar verteilen; föhnen oder lufttrocknen lassen.
formula_observations: Classic synthetic polymer mousse: PVP (pos 4) and VP/VA Copolymer (pos 5) right after the propellants (propane/butane), Polyquaternium-16 (pos 10, cationic, curl-friendly film) and Chitosan (natural film former, low). Silicones present: Dimethicone, Dimethiconol (plus isododecane as volatile carrier) and Macadamia seed oil at the tail. No alcohol denat. Foam stabilised by PEG-40 hydrogenated castor oil + Laureth-4. Parabens (methyl) + phenoxyethanol as preservative.
notes: Claim-vs-claim: same dm page says 'Starker Halt bis zu 24 Stunden' (title + bullet) but the dm Merkmal 'Halt' = 'leichter Halt'. Formula carries dimethicone/dimethiconol, so it is NOT silicone-free (no free-from claim made on dm.de; do not assume 'ohne Silikone' for curl foams - CG-incompatible). Boundary doubt: 'Locken' positioning, but chemically a generic PVP/VP-VA foam, same family as 'Volumen' foams. Rossmann listing for same EAN seen in search (not INCI-checked).

formula_observations: NO synthetic film-forming fixative (no PVP, VP/VA, PQ-4/11/16/46, acrylates). Only polymer is Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (pos 10, a conditioning/detangling guar, not a fixative at that position). Alcohol Denat at position 2 as carrier; cetrimonium chloride (pos 3) + panthenol + hydrolyzed collagen = conditioning/film. Polyglyceryl caprate/caprylate act as preservative boosters. No silicones, no oils, no propellants. Volume claim rests on collagen + cationic conditioner, not on a fixative.
notes: Claim-vs-formula: sold as 'Stylinglotion für Volumen' and carries no hold statement; the formula has no identifiable fixative or any dedicated heat-protection ingredient (no silicone/PVP/etc.), so '200°C Hitzeschutz' and 'Volumen' are marketing positions around a conditioning lotion. Boundary: behaves like a leave-in/heat-protect pre-treatment, not a setting lotion in the fixative sense. Can also be used on dry hair before irons. Same pattern: GUHL Föhnlotion Seidenglanz (dm 1447163): Aqua, Alcohol Denat., PEG-450, PEG-10 Dimethicone, PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil... no fixative, claims 'leichte Kämmbarkeit, Glanz, Styling'.

No synthetic fixative (no PVP/VP-VA/PQ/acrylates). Named 'Föhn-Spray' not 'Lotion' but functionally the same slot as a Föhnlotion with fixative (spray onto damp hair before blow-drying) - boundary probe vs heat_styling_spray. Also contains an alcohol-denat carrier, i.e. alcohol-led despite a 'natural' positioning (89 % natürlichen Ursprungs).

formula_observations: Foam format but a hairspray-type formula: Alcohol Denat (pos 2) + dimethyl ether + butane/propane propellants, and PVM/MA copolymer esters (butyl and ethyl ester, pos 5 and 8; the classic alcohol-soluble hairspray resin) with VP/Methacrylamide/Vinyl Imidazole Copolymer (pos 11). Applied to roots only; 'über Nacht einwirken' is unusual. Price 1,95 EUR (dm).

formula_observations: Alcohol-led pump spray: Alcohol Denat (pos 2) plus Isopropyl Alcohol (pos 5, drying solvent). Fixatives: VP/VA Copolymer (pos 3) + Acrylates/t-Butylacrylamide Copolymer (pos 4; the stiff, humidity-resistant hairspray polymer). Only care ingredient: panthenol. No silicones, oils or propellants. Very short INCI (~14 items).
notes: Claim-vs-formula: marketed as a volume 'Styling Spray' that is 'leicht auskämmbar' with 'flexiblem Halt', but dm filters it as 'sehr starker Halt' and the polymer pair (VP/VA + acrylates/t-butylacrylamide) is a hairspray-grade system with two alcohols. Applied to damp roots then through lengths - so it is a root-first volumizer, but also usable dry (hairspray overlap). Boundary vs hairspray/heat_styling_spray. Product name changed over time (Volumenspray Ultra / Föhn-Spray Ultra Volumen on older URLs). dm.de page showed 'nicht lieferbar' in a search snapshot.
